unit_note: USD millions. Table 5 uses dots for no transactions and (**) for amounts below $500,000 in absolute value. Both marks are omitted from the numeric cells. The Food and Nutrition Service subtotal includes the four printed program lines, including the WIC label that wraps across two lines. Audit #600 confirmed that the prior-year Rural Electrification and Telecommunications Fund gross outlay is marked (**), with -1 in applicable receipts and 1 in outlays. Both figures feed the department total in the companion unit.
